description: SvelteKit phase 2 (docs/design/M6-SVELTEKIT.md): the shadcn-svelte site's markdown pages for Toggle, Tabs and Separator, generated by the site's velite collection and mdsx configuration with its previews preprocessor (runic generate), loaded through import.meta.glob as component values, with the sidebar from server data and each page's highlighted component source from a prerendered endpoint (build-time tables; {@html} of build-time fragments), compared with the fixture's own Kit build (adapter-static, client-rendered) in Chromium. At 800px with the table of contents: a toggle preview pressed, table-of-contents links followed (fragment navigation scrolling the page pane, focus cleared), the installation tabs switched to Manual (the endpoint's highlighted source), the outline preview's bold toggle, the sidebar link to Tabs, the tabs demo activated by click and ArrowRight, the icons section and its Code tab, back, back and forward
